en: Mount Apo is the highest mountain in the Philippines, standing at exactly 2,954 meters above sea level.
The Philippines declared independence from Spain on June 12, 1898, ending exactly 333 years of Spanish colonial rule.
The Philippine Congress has two chambers, with the Senate having 24 members and the House having over 300.
The Philippines has over 180 distinct languages, but only Filipino and English serve as the two official languages.
The annual Sinulog festival in Cebu draws over one million tourists every third Sunday of January.
National hero Jose Rizal wrote his final poem, Mi Ultimo Adios, which contains exactly 14 four-line stanzas.
Indigenous Ifugao people carved the Banaue Rice Terraces 2,000 years ago, reaching elevations up to 1,500 meters.
Dr. Fe del Mundo became the first Asian admitted to Harvard Medical School, graduating in 1940 at age 29.
The Philippine eagle, the national bird, stands about one meter tall and possesses a two-meter wingspan.
The Philippines comprises 7,641 islands, but only about 2,000 of these islands are permanently inhabited by people.
National Artist Juan Luna painted the Spoliarium, which measures 4.22 meters long and 7.645 meters wide.
A Filipino citizen must be at least 18 years old to vote, but at least 35 to run for president.
